description: Network synchronization provides a common time and frequency reference for distributed radio components. Precise timing limits jitter and asynchrony and is essential for coordinated transmission, mobility, and high data rates.

featured.title: Robust mmWave/sub-THz multi-connectivity using minimal coordination and coarse synchronization
featured.authors: L. Miretti, G. Caire, und S. Stańczak
featured.summary: Investigates “Robust mmWave/sub-THz multi-connectivity using minimal coordination and coarse synchronization”. Focus: the core mechanism, system behavior and engineering implications in Network Synchronization & Timing, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
